title: Reproduce synthetic pipeline and audit its failure gates
question: Do existing offline Python and R smoke tests catch label leakage, sample-mismatch and unsupported biological claims consistently?
scope: Software engineering only; use synthetic fixtures and zero human data.
steps: Run the Python test suite and synthetic demo; run synthetic R tests where dependencies exist.
Record exact versions, failing commands, seeds and failed gates rather than declaring success from an exit code alone.
File reproducible code fixes only when a test demonstrates a defect.
deliverables: A compact engineering audit in the PR, with commands, environment, results and remaining uncertainty.
Synthetic regression tests for any defects fixed.
acceptance: All tests and claims are explicitly labeled software-only.
Failures and skipped R checks are recorded, never represented as passes.
No external network or human sample data are used.
